package.description: Every AI coding limit, on your Windows 11 taskbar.

en-US.description: Every AI coding limit, on your Windows 11 taskbar.
en-US.longDescription: CodexWinBar puts your AI coding-provider usage limits directly on the Windows 11 taskbar — embedded next to the system tray — with per-provider session and weekly windows, reset countdowns, credits, an optional usage-pace projection, and live provider-status incidents. Supports Codex, Claude, Copilot, OpenRouter, OpenAI Admin, z.ai, and Cursor.
en-US.name: CodexWinBar
